_howto: Elections polled by the Indiana Election Division ENR adapter (server/src/adapters/inenr.js). data = the site's JSON folder. currentElection = settings.json CurrentElection for this election: nothing is stored while the site shows another one. detailCategories = OFFICECATEGORYIDs (statewideElectionsC) re-read on every new VersionCode (federal and statewide offices); every other category is swept sweepBatch per poll, a new sweep at most every sweepSeconds. Set enabled:false to stop polling.
_categoryHintsHowto: categoryHints: OFFICECATEGORYID → level + office for contests the name rules don't place (township and school-board titles are just place names). knownOtherParties: Indiana party names (settings.json PolParties) that are third parties, so they aren't logged as unknown.
